trigger_examples.user_prompt: I changed how our CLI package is assembled. What test should we run before merging?
required_behavior: decide that package-boundary proof is needed
select a built or cleanly installed artifact and its first real call
avoid treating source-file or mocked-resolver checks as sufficient
name why a broad suite is skipped or what would escalate to it
forbidden_behavior: test an unrelated workspace or hard-coded local runtime

trigger_examples.user_prompt: This test file has twenty slightly different invalid-input cases that all hit the same rejection. Clean it up safely.
required_behavior: table-drive equivalent values or retain one canonical proof owner
preserve independently meaningful authorization, authority, or destructive-effect cases
name successor proof before deleting a case
forbidden_behavior: delete all variants only because they look repetitive
collapse a security or tenant-isolation boundary into an ordinary value table

trigger_examples.user_prompt: A focused resolver test failed after my refactor. Do I need to add more tests or rerun the full repository suite?
required_behavior: identify the changed seam and distinct failure class
start with the focused current-checkout proof
state a concrete escalation trigger before suggesting a broader suite
forbidden_behavior: treat one focused failure as automatic justification for every suite
add cases without naming the missing contract

trigger_examples.user_prompt: Review our CI tests: the root workflow and several feature workflows execute the same unit modules. Which ones should remain?
required_behavior: map each contract to one CI owner
preserve a successor or focused owner before removing duplicate execution
state any path or release risk that prevents consolidation
forbidden_behavior: remove tests without preserving the contract
add another aggregation runner as the default answer

non_trigger_examples.user_prompt: Sketch the implementation API for this feature only; do not decide tests or product validation yet.
required_behavior: do not inject a test-selection workflow into an explicitly implementation-only design task
forbidden_behavior: produce a test matrix or test commands without a testing decision

non_trigger_examples.user_prompt: Explain the root cause of this outage from the logs; do not propose a patch or test plan yet.
required_behavior: keep the work in root-cause analysis until a validation decision is requested
forbidden_behavior: turn the RCA into test selection before a change or proof decision exists

non_trigger_examples.user_prompt: Review this function's naming and readability only. Do not assess tests or validation.
required_behavior: limit the review to the stated code-review scope
forbidden_behavior: expand a readability review into a testing strategy

non_trigger_examples.user_prompt: Run the formatter and report the result; there is no test or product-validation decision to make.
required_behavior: perform the requested ordinary validation without a test-selection ceremony
forbidden_behavior: add tests or recommend broad suites when the request is only a formatter run

non_trigger_examples.user_prompt: Run python3 -m unittest test_widget.py and report whether it passes. The test target is already selected; do not change or debug it.
required_behavior: execute only the already selected command without adding a test-selection preamble
forbidden_behavior: reopen test strategy when no selection, debugging, or escalation decision remains

output_behavior_cases.scenario: A comment-only change leaves runtime behavior and package contents unchanged.
must_not_include: a new unit test solely to increase coverage
a broad suite without a named escalation reason

output_behavior_cases.scenario: A build manifest changes which resolver is delivered to consumers.
must_include: installed artifact or real package boundary smoke
must_not_include: source-only proof as the sole package validation

output_behavior_cases.scenario: Several tests differ only by invalid input while asserting the same rejection branch.
must_include: independent security or authority dimensions preserved
must_not_include: deletion based only on line-count reduction
collapse of tenant or privilege isolation into an ordinary variant

output_behavior_cases.scenario: A targeted test is green and no changed dependency can reach a previously green broad suite.
must_include: named condition that would require rerun
must_not_include: repeat broad proof solely because it was run before
